method: Input-to-protocol-ack is a proxy; rAF bounds/opacity samples are pose proxies. Actual CDP PNG hashes count changes in the canvas region INCLUDING the selection overlay, so they corroborate rendered output but do not independently prove artwork-only feedback Hz. All frame/rebuild gaps and raw inputs are retained; no target PASS or causal attribution.

finalPointerupPoseProxy.method: Expected source X from starting observed pose plus authored screen displacement/actual stage scale; first post-pointerup rAF bounds sample after last wrong sample, within 1 source px, through next drag. This is a bounds proxy with sampled gaps, not pixel latency. High-rate pointerup XY is stale Playwright driver state and cannot qualify final-pointerup target.
